shared_elements: figure set within a framed/recessed panel
justification: The only real correspondence is the presence of a frontal standing human figure set inside a bounded panel, which is about as generic as figural carving gets. A shows a densely populated two-register scene with a row of armed figures above and a mounted rider on a large animal below, all inside a zigzag border, whereas B shows a single isolated figure on an otherwise blank cut surface with no companions, animals, attributes or ornamental framing.
